description: Canonical dataset ends 2026-08-10 (3,499 parsed / 3,491 decisive episodes); no post-2026-08-10 data exists as of 2026-08-11 (re-verified this phase, unchanged since Phase 4.5b)
impact: Caps all OOS runway for counters detected late in the window; caps evaluation resolution improvements
mitigation_or_next_step: Re-check Kaggle for new daily dumps periodically; do not scale the existing window further

description: Ogerpon->Grimmsnarl (n=17) and Dragapult->Fezandipiti (n=15) both detected too close to the dataset endpoint to reach the n>=25 primary OOS bar
impact: Leaves 2 promising counters formally unresolved rather than confirmed or rejected
mitigation_or_next_step: Re-run the unchanged Phase 4.4/4.5 pipeline once new data exists; do not lower the OOS bar to force a verdict

description: Per-side player/opponent rating cannot be reliably resolved from the unordered score-pair field in the source data; both resolution methods tested are indistinguishable from chance (~49-53% accuracy) across every bucket and archetype
impact: Rating-based analysis and rating-aware strategies cannot be trusted at any sample size -- this is structural not a sample-size gap
mitigation_or_next_step: Exclude rating from all decision-policy inputs (already enforced); would require a different/richer data source to resolve

description: Only 42 of thousands of possible directed archetype pairs reach games>=20 in the full dataset; only 5 pairs ever reached the CANDIDATE stage of counter detection
impact: The vast majority of possible matchups have no usable evidence either way
mitigation_or_next_step: Treat any matchup outside the tracked registry as unknown

description: Meta share and matchup strength both shift materially over the 56-day window (e.g. Grimmsnarl 8.5%->44.3%); meta-aware/recency strategies are measurably weakest during high-change weeks/days
impact: A validated counter or baseline can be invalidated by future meta drift even without new statistical evidence of failure
mitigation_or_next_step: Version and re-validate the policy whenever meta composition shifts materially
column6: not just on a fixed schedule

description: Deck-selection-level effects (Conservative Meta-Aware ~1.3-2.6pp over Most Popular) are much smaller and harder to demonstrate at conventional significance than raw matchup-level effects (which can exceed 30pp)
impact: Aggregate strategy comparisons need much larger day/game counts than single-matchup validation to reach reliable conclusions
mitigation_or_next_step: Prioritize narrow validated-matchup rules over general scoring-model sophistication given current data volume
